```{r}
#| label: load-value-box-functions
source("info_valuebox.R")
info_value_box_styles()
```

## 2 x 2 layout

```{r}
#| label: display-value-boxes

boxes <- list(
  info_value_box("All cause mortality", 39.9),
  info_value_box(
    "All cause mortality",
    4.0,
    stat = "ratio",
    measure = "Age-specific mortality rates",
    group = "85+ years",
    reference = "75\u201384 years"
  ),
  info_value_box("COPD", -12.3, type = "trend", from = 2010, to = 2020),
  info_value_box("Dementia", 25.2)
)

# Layout is controlled here. All layouts stack below 640px.
do.call(info_value_box_layout, c(boxes, list(columns = 2)))
```

## 3 cards in a row
```{r alt_layouts}
# Alternatives using the same cards:
do.call(info_value_box_layout, boxes[1:3]) # three cards in one row
# do.call(info_value_box_layout, boxes[1:2]) # two cards in one row
```
